doctrine_note: The immutable blind stays the CORE predictor and is never edited. Direction here is the blind's own D-1-tilt direction (DOWN, and it was right). The MBO/causal layer supplies MAGNITUDE, TURN, and SHAPE only. Magnitudes are DERIVED from the phase table, the never-masked activity fields and the realized-excursion/reclaim structure - never fitted to the actual. The honest bar is applied in both directions: where the causal read supports less than the actual I emit less, and where my blind's own instruments were declared-defective I say so rather than back-fill. General mechanisms only; every n is stated and nothing with n=1 is proposed for merge. Book layer STOOD DOWN for this whole group (see stand_down_reasons).
cross_cutting_mbo_finding: G23's block-wide misread is one mechanism seen from five angles: FLOWLESS PRICE MOVEMENT WAS LABELLED ABSORPTION. The block's single biggest move (0709 phase 2: -1,860 USD on 98,400 lots with net aggressor flow of -11) carried essentially ZERO net aggressor participation. Absorption means flow is CONSUMED and price HOLDS; this was the inverse - price moved and no flow was transacted, i.e. the resting bid was withdrawn, a liquidity-void reprice. Because nothing was transferred at the new level, the level was untested and the market kept going: -660 the next session and -620 the one after. Meanwhile the phase that WAS absorption on 0709 (phase 3: +1,390 of aggressive buying bought only -160 of price; the evidence file's own ph_absorb[2]=true and absorb_session=true) was read by the blind as a bullish 'buy handover'. So the blind inverted the polarity on the exact phase the evidence had already flagged, and applied the absorption label to the phase that was its opposite. Both errors pushed the same way - less bearish - which is why five of five specialists' worth of down-conviction (only two of us even called DOWN) came out capped. This is structurally available to any price-masked agent: with price hidden, 'net flow ~ 0 on record volume' looks exactly like absorption and there is no way to tell it from a void. That is the single most transferable thing G23 produced.

target_1_what_owned_the_block_down_move.channel: SUPPLY-SIDE LOOSENESS CONFIRMED AT THE DEMAND PEAK. The week 0708-0713 was the summer's local demand top - gw_cdd 14.4 on my D0, est_gas_burn 45.4 Bcf/d, ngwu power burn +6.3 Bcf/d WoW stated (+16%) - and the balance STILL loosened through it. The 0709 print put the L48 injection at +61 Bcf against a 5-year pace of +56 (storage_regional l48 chg_vs_5yr_chg = +5.0), widening the surplus from +151 to +156 vs 5yr. Alongside it, the jul26 STEO vintage revised dry production UP in all three months against the prior vintage (+0.118 / +0.237 / +0.268) with dry production running 109.4 Bcf/d on the ngwu week ending 0708. The market's read, and it is the only read that fits the tape, is: if the balance cannot tighten at 45 Bcf/d of burn and 14.4 CDD, the whole summer strip is mispriced. That repriced the front over four sessions (-520, -2,050, -660, -620 = -3,850 from the 0707 close) and then STOPPED - which is the confirming half of the same story.

Burn ran 43.3 -> 47.2 -> 48.8 -> 51.0 Bcf/d on periods 0712-0715, the CDD ladder jumped to 15.382 / 16.312, and the price went 2.886 -> 2.906 -> 2.900 -> 2.898 -> 2.916, a net +30 over four sessions. target_1_what_owned_the_block_down_move.why_my_own_down_read_was_capped: Three stacked caps, ranked by damage. CAP 1 (largest, and it is my own play): the burn_conversion_gate was run as a SUPPRESSOR. My blind text is explicit - 'a down-lean with burn ramping AGAINST it is SUPPRESSED to the constraint-floor class, -150..-200. I take p50 -150.' That single move set the answer before magnitude was ever derived, and it did so using the very fact (burn at its weekly high) that was the block's bearish evidence, not its bullish counterweight. CAP 2 (removed the driver): the D-1 phase misread. Calling 0709's flowless -1,860 'absorbed dead flat' and its failed +1,390 bid a 'buy handover' let me write the bearish balance channel off as 'SPENT ON THE TAPE'. Having deleted the driver, there was nothing left to size against. CAP 3 (set the wrong universe): the magnitude scaler. I used a vol_regime family I had myself declared degraded (0.226 of the leg tape) plus G22 quiet-day classes (-60/-160/+410), while the never-masked fields in the same slice showed D-1 at 155,141 lots and -2,050. That is why the BAND failed as well as the point - -660 was outside [-450, +250] and could not have been inside it with a G22-quiet-day universe. Any one of the three caps alone produces a light number; all three stacked produce -150 against -660.

target_2_the_0709_print_and_the_absorbed.what_the_print_handed_my_session: Two things, and I took the wrong one from each. (a) A PRICE COLLAPSE WITH NO AGGRESSOR PARTICIPATION: main phase -1,860 USD on 98,400 lots at net flow -11. Nothing was transferred; the bid was withdrawn rather than consumed. A level reached without transfer is untested, which is why it was pressed again inside twelve hours - and pressed by REAL flow this time (0710 ph2, -3,185). (b) A FAILED BID: final phase +1,390 of aggressive buying purchasing -160 of price on 50,946 lots, flagged ph_absorb TRUE and absorb_session TRUE in the evidence file I was reading. Dip-buyers were absorbed. (c) The corroborating price-free tell I had and under-weighted: 0709's l1 quote_bid_share printed 0.475, the block MINIMUM (most ask-leaned resting book of all ten sessions) on the block's maximum quote_updates 329,160 and maximum volume 155,141. When aggressor flow is ~0 but the resting book is at its most ask-leaned of the block, the passive side is making the price. My blind cited the 0.475 - as a minor confirmation of a 'flat-to-sell residual', not as the discriminator it is.
target_2_the_0709_print_and_the_absorbed.did_absorbed_survive_the_price_curve: NO. It fails twice, and in opposite directions, which is the informative part. First, the label was attached to the WRONG PHASE: I called phase 2 'absorbed' when phase 2 moved -1,860 - absorption by definition requires price to HOLD while flow is eaten, and here price moved while no flow was eaten. That is a liquidity void, the opposite object. Second, the phase that genuinely WAS absorption - phase 3, flagged as such by the evidence file - I labelled a bullish 'buy handover'. So the polarity was inverted on the flagged phase and the label was misapplied to the unflagged one. Both errors reduced bearishness, and together they produced the sentence in my blind that did the actual damage: 'the fundamental stack is bearish but SPENT ON THE TAPE'. It was not spent. It was mid-delivery.
target_2_the_0709_print_and_the_absorbed.the_generalizable_form: Absorption and liquidity-void are distinguished by WHICH of flow and price is large, and a price-masked agent can only see one of them. See proposal_contribution item 2 for the blind-available discriminator.

target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.the_play: weather.burn_conversion_gate, status PROPOSED, merged S110, mine. Trigger: any weather-slope directional lean in a CDD regime. Call: 'burn-confirmed slope lean = full band; wind-on/burn-down = suppress the up-lean toward the constraint floor (-150..-200 class); the gate reads BOTH WAYS (an up-lean must check wind is not contradicting; a down-lean must check burn is not ramping)'. Evidence at merge: SIX instances, ALL INSIDE G22, one block, never cross-block. Pre-registered falsifier: 'a burn-confirmed CDD add that fails to deliver, or a wind-on day that delivers gross-CDD anyway, in G23+'. G23 was the forward test.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.verdict: REFUTED. Not mis-scoped, not softened - the play's own pre-registered falsifier fired, on both of its polarities, in the block it named as its forward test.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.falsification_1_the_up_polarity: The two-limb flip test re-run against the realized weekend (full arithmetic under handoff_out.two_limb_test_rerun) resolves BOTH LIMBS PASS: a coherent multi-horizon CDD ADD of +1.840 / +1.969 / +3.245 gw-CDD across 0713/0714/0715 against my frozen vintage, comfortably clearing the >= +1.0 D0 bar and the same-sign coherence requirement; and Sat-over-Sat burn UP at 43.5 vs 42.9 Bcf/d with wind DOWN 11% (844,507 vs 951,711 MWh), so the damper is clean too. My own verdict table says BOTH PASS -> flip Monday UP, full band +300..+800. Monday delivered -620. That is a burn-confirmed CDD add that failed to deliver, verbatim, and it would have converted a correct DOWN call into a wrong UP call with an error of roughly +920 to +1,420. And it was not a one-session accident: burn ran 47.2 / 48.8 / 51.0 Bcf/d on the following periods against a 15.4-16.3 CDD ladder while price moved +30 over four sessions.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.falsification_2_the_down_polarity: On my own day the gate did not support a lean, it CAPPED one - the both-ways clause ('a down-lean must check burn is not ramping') suppressed my DOWN to the -150..-200 constraint floor on the strength of burn at 45.4 Bcf/d. Actual -660. So the suppression arm failed on the same block as the confirmation arm, on the same driver, in the same week. A gate that is wrong in both directions on the same evidence is not mis-scoped, it is measuring the wrong quantity.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.the_mechanism_of_the_failure: The gate reads a NUMERATOR with no DENOMINATOR. 'Does burn confirm the CDD add' asks whether demand showed up; it never asks whether the demand CLEARED THE BALANCE. In G23 the decision-visible balance answered plainly: at 45.4 Bcf/d of burn - the summer high - the weekly injection still ran +5 Bcf ABOVE the 5-year pace and the surplus WIDENED 151 -> 156, with STEO revising production up three months running. In that state, more burn is not bullish information; it is the test of the balance, and the balance failed it. The gate had no term that could see the difference between burn that tightens and burn that is being covered.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.what_this_does_and_does_not_license: It kills the sign-bearing and suppression uses of the gate as written. It does NOT license a replacement rule from this block: the two G23 failures share one week, one driver and one balance state, so honestly they are n=2 instances of n=1 independent episode, and the general-mechanism bar (n>=2 spanning groups) is not met. A successor carrying the balance-clearing term is offered in proposal_contribution item 1 as a PROPOSAL with its own falsifier, and it must be tested on a block where the balance is tightening before anything is merged. Also worth recording against my own G22 evidence: six instances in a single block was never adequate support, and the first out-of-sample block killed it.
target_3_burn_conversion_gate_falsifier.not_softened: Stated plainly because it is my play: the burn_conversion_gate was wrong on G23, in both directions, and the miss on 0710 is directly traceable to my having applied it.

item_1_burn_conversion_gate_kill_and_suc.kind: REFUTATION of a merged PROPOSED play (mine), plus a successor proposal
item_1_burn_conversion_gate_kill_and_suc.refutation: weather.burn_conversion_gate is REFUTED on its own pre-registered falsifier in its own named forward-test block. Both polarities failed on the same driver in the same week: the confirmation arm called Monday UP +300..+800 on a coherent burn-confirmed CDD add that delivered -620, and the suppression arm capped a correct DOWN to a -150..-200 floor on a day that delivered -660. n=2 instances, n=1 independent episode. The original G22 support was 6 instances inside ONE block and never spanned - that support level should be read as insufficient going forward, which is the second lesson.
item_1_burn_conversion_gate_kill_and_suc.successor_proposal: weather.burn_conversion_requires_balance_clearing. TRIGGER: any weather-slope directional lean in a CDD regime where a burn confirmation is about to be used as a sign or a suppressor. READ: burn confirmation answers whether demand ARRIVED; it does not answer whether demand CLEARED THE BALANCE, and only the second question carries price. The clearing test is served free and decision-legit: storage_regional.<region>.chg_vs_5yr_chg (the week's injection against the 5-year pace) plus the surplus level's direction, cross-checked against the STEO vintage's production revision sign. CALL: burn confirmation is licensed as a sign input ONLY when the balance is clearing (injection at or below the 5-year pace, surplus flat-to-narrowing); when the balance is LOOSENING at a demand peak (injection above pace, surplus widening, production revised up), burn confirmation is BEARISH information, not bullish - it is the balance failing its test - and it must never be used to suppress a down-lean. SCOPE: CDD regime; the HDD mirror is unmeasured and must not be assumed. REQUIRES: storage_regional, storage, steo_vintage, grid_stack, weather_forecast ladder. FALSIFIER: a block in which the balance is loosening at a demand peak and the burn-confirmed CDD add DOES deliver up, or a block in which a clearing balance plus burn confirmation fails to deliver. n: 1 episode (G23). NOT ELIGIBLE FOR MERGE - it needs a block where the balance is tightening before it means anything, and a rule derived from the same week that killed its predecessor is a hypothesis, not a finding.

item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.kind: NEW mechanism proposal - the highest-value item in this file
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.trigger: a session phase whose net aggressor signed flow is near zero while its price change is a large share of the session range
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.read: This is NOT absorption and must not be labelled as such. Absorption = flow CONSUMED, price HOLDS (the classic form: 0709 phase 3, +1,390 of aggressive buying purchasing -160 of price). A large move on ~zero net flow is the inverse object: the resting side WITHDREW. Nothing was transferred at the new level, so the level is untested and undefended, and the market presses it again.
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.call: a flowless reprice hands CONTINUATION, not reversal, and the following session's magnitude class must be scaled off the reprice day's own delivered move, never off the pre-event vol regime. An absorption phase in the classic form keeps its existing reversal reading (direction.absorption_is_reversal) - the two objects are opposite and must not share a label.
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.blind_available_discriminator: This is the part that matters, because the misread is structurally available to a price-masked agent. Blind, phase_signed_flow and phase_volume_lots are never masked but the phase price change is - so 'near-zero flow on record volume' is genuinely ambiguous. The price-free tie-breaker is the resting book: l1_book.quote_bid_share. On 0709 it printed 0.475, the block MINIMUM across ten sessions (most ask-leaned resting book), alongside block-max quote_updates 329,160 and block-max volume 155,141. When aggressor flow is ~0 on heavy volume, the PASSIVE lean carries the direction, because the passive side is the one making the price. IMPORTANT NEGATIVE RESULT, so this is not overclaimed: quote_bid_share is NOT a general day-ahead direction signal - tested as D-1 bid_share into D's net across the block it scores 6/10, i.e. nothing. The claim is strictly conditional on the flowless-phase case, where it is a LABELLER, not a predictor.
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.evidence: 0709 phase 2: sflow -11 on 98,400 lots, px -1,860 (the block's single largest phase move), quote_bid_share at the block minimum. Consequence: 0710 -660 and 0713 -620, i.e. two further sessions of continuation - the level was pressed twice more. Paired counter-object in the same session: 0709 phase 3, the classic absorption form, which also resolved DOWN, consistent with the existing absorption play.
item_2_flowless_reprice_is_not_absorptio.n_and_status: n=1 phase instance in G23 (with an in-session paired counter-object). NOT ELIGIBLE FOR MERGE. Forward test is cheap and should be run: sweep the G17-G22 phase tables for phases with |sflow| < ~150 and volume > ~40,000 lots, and check the following session's direction and the D-1 quote_bid_share extremity. If that sweep produces n>=2 spanning groups, this is the strongest candidate the MBO layer has generated.
